body: I really recommend this movie, very funny with a great concept and plot twist. Ahmed Helmy did a great hard work on this movie, 3 characters with three different personalities and in some scenes they all wear the same outfit and Ahmed have to by acting letting the viewer tell the difference between who is who, this is a genius at work. Khaled El Sawi was perfect for his role and the most important thing is they focused in the details and I appreciate these movies.
Amazing film and it will take you to another time like time travel

This movie has an original story that was never introduced before in Cinema. It is funny and also has drama. The acting is amazing and the idea of this movie was copied to make the film "what happened to Monday" released in 2018 meaning 11 years after this movie but the difference is that this movie is being very real and happening in its original time with no weird stupid fancy future stuff showing you how would that unfold infront of your eyes if it happened today (and by today I mean 2007 of course). The film is great for family viewing and the acting is amazing and also the direction is great. 10 stars for this movie for it is first of a time story.
